name: The Robotic Athanor
description: The Robotic Athanor is an online forum devoted to discussions of robot-assisted experimentation with medieval alchemy. Members share build logs, debate alchemical theory, and post results from their robotic alchemy rigs. The forum has sections for Build Logs, Alchemical Theory, Manuscript Analysis, and Buy/Sell/Trade. All members live in SF / Bay Area in 2026.
default_invitation: A new thread has just opened on the Alchemical Theory section. The forum is active and members are posting throughout the day.
